name: 13846-visionprefill-internvl26b-tp4
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: InternVLChatModel -- a 45-layer InternViT-6B vision tower and a 2-layer MLP projector feeding a 48-layer InternLM2 decoder. bf16, 51.0 GB over 11 safetensors, so 12.8 GB of weights per card at TP4.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4 (pinned), warmup the first 25%, bounded at 1200 requests with an 1800 s safety cap; ~900 requests are left measured.
workload: guidellm two-source multimodal chat, SINGLE TURN: `synthetic_text` at exactly 512 prompt tokens and 64 output tokens, plus one `synthetic_image` 448x448 jpeg (quality 85, gradient, randomised per row so no two requests share an image), `temperature: 0.0` and `ignore_eos: true`. 448x448 is exactly the checkpoint's force_image_size, so the tiler emits one tile and no thumbnail and the image is a deterministic 256 tokens -- ~768 prompt tokens per request, every time.
purpose: A vision chat assistant answering single-turn questions about one 448-pixel image each, four concurrent users, four GPUs.
launch:
# sglang 0.5.5.post3 at commit ecefc7904f08d05f502a00a4d915140ecd08d07c.
# The checkpoint ships a custom modelling file and tokenizer, so trust-remote-code is required.
# host / port / served-model-name are owned by the serving layer and must not be set here.

model-path: OpenGVLab/InternVL2_5-26B
tp-size: 4
trust-remote-code: true
dtype: auto

enable-multimodal: true
chat-template: internvl-2-5

attention-backend: flashinfer
mem-fraction-static: 0.7
max-running-requests: 4
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
disable-radix-cache: true

enable-piecewise-cuda-graph: true
piecewise-cuda-graph-max-tokens: 8192
piecewise-cuda-graph-compiler: eager
